tracked-job poll writes use owner, failure count, and prior-poll timestamp fences
background operation projections are monotonic and terminal-safe
scheduled occurrence claims and transitions use owner, state, lease, and revision fences
scheduler chat publication is atomic with occurrence/run/effect state
Deep scheduler composition uses the one application Plane runtime and no raw SQL or legacy pool
work-admission configuration binds only after caller commit
async admission and concurrency are bounded
async adapter exposes callbacks over typed transactions, never generic SQL
